key_insight: A Gemini-based agent autonomously discovered and formally verified compact, Collatz-like execution rules for eleven six-state Busy Beaver candidate machines.
engineering_relevance: The work illustrates how AI conjecture generation can pair with formal verification to produce trustworthy symbolic summaries of complex program execution.
method: Recognize patterns in Turing-machine execution and conjecture compact acceleration rules.
Use informal mathematical reasoning to develop proofs of those rules.
Formally verify the discovered accelerations in Lean.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports novel, formally verified accelerations for eleven BB(6) machines, but their halting behavior remains unresolved.
watch_item: Verified accelerations do not settle halting, and the proposed Cryptid classifications remain provisional pending community acceptance.
paper_title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
